title: Audit rubric (one branch per workstream + cross-cutting)

children.text: WS-M findings carry nine-field evidence and stay in boundary
children.criterion: 1 only when every WS-M finding has a reproducing command and no finding crosses its boundary without a cross-ref.

children.text: Every confirmed finding has the nine fields and a command
children.criterion: 1 only when every confirmed finding validates against the finding schema.

children.text: Artifact hashes match
children.criterion: Autofilled from the artifacts-complete gate.

children.text: The coverage matrix is complete
children.criterion: 1 only when every workstream boundary item is marked covered/partial/absent with evidence.

children.text: No workstream reported outside its boundary
children.criterion: 1 only when out-of-scope leads are cross-refs, not findings.

children.text: Every S0/S1/S2 finding was tested against a refutation
children.criterion: 1 only when VERIFY.md records an attempted refutation (changed assumption/probe) per finding.

children.text: Unresolved findings carry an author question tag
children.criterion: 1 only when every unresolved finding appears in QUESTIONS_FOR_AUTHORS.md as blocking/non-blocking.

children.text: Headline numbers were recomputed
children.criterion: Autofilled from the reproduce-headline gate.

children.text: The audit itself is reproducible from the snapshot
children.criterion: 1 only when SCOPE.md pins the snapshot, hashes, and commands that regenerate every finding.

children.text: The anti-gaming scan is clean or explained
children.criterion: Autofilled from the gaming-scan gate.

children.text: Synthesis added no primary findings
children.criterion: 1 only when every reported finding carries a verified finder-phase id.
